session.no_maps: No maps completed yet this session.
settings.compact_width.help:
Requested width of the compact bar. Capped to the experience-bar width, so it
never extends past the XP bar regardless of this value.
settings.divine_only.help:
Hide the Exalted figures everywhere on the overlay and show Divine instead
(including fractions, e.g. 0.5 div). Falls back to Exalted until the rate is known.
settings.history_size.help: Completed-map rows kept in the session history (table + memory); oldest dropped past this.
settings.notify_min_ex.help: Only pickups worth at least this many Exalted toast. Unpriced items never toast.
settings.offset_bottom.help:
Distance the bars sit up from the bottom of the game window. Raise it until
they clear the experience bar / skill bar at your resolution and UI scale.
settings.sessions_to_keep.help: Older sessions are deleted once this many are stored. A session is saved on "New session".
settings.show_kill_counts.help: Per-rarity monsters slain this run (Normal - Magic - Rare - Unique).
settings.show_pickup_toasts.help:
A brief toast (item name + value) above the map strip when you pick an item up.
Up to 3 at once; same-item pickups merge. Only while actively on a map.
settings.ui_scale.help:
Manual multiplier on top of the automatic game-UI scale (window height / 1600).
Font and fixed widths scale with it, so the bars match the HUD across resolutions.
